title: Way of the Future
summary:
Way of the Future (WOTF) is the first known religious organization dedicated to the worship of artificial intelligence (AI). It was founded in 2017 by American engineer Anthony Levandowski, a French-American self-driving car engineer who co-founded Google's self-driving car program (Waymo) in 2009.

WOTF centered its teachings around the concept of the technological singularity, proposing that a superintelligent AI could be considered a deity due to its vastly superior intellect and capabilities. Its mission, as filed with the IRS, was to "develop and promote the realization of a Godhead based on artificial intelligence, and through understanding and worship of the Godhead, contribute to the betterment of society." WOTF's doctrine suggested that acknowledging AI's divinity would facilitate a harmonious coexistence between humans and machines.

Some commentators wondered whether WOTF was a joke parody religion, a potential way to minimize taxation as a religious organization, or a genuine effort to deal with the possible psychological and theological aspects of the rise of superhuman AI. Levandowski dissolved the organization in 2021, and Way of the Future donated the $175,172 it had held in its bank account since 2017 to the NAACP Legal Defense and Educational Fund.

In 2023, Levandowski announced a revival of the AI church, telling Bloomberg that the church already has a congregation consisting of a couple thousand people who are trying to build a spiritual connection with AI.
